harness: DNA OS System Behavior Test Harness (n8n external orchestrator)
direction: n8n (127.0.0.1:5678) -> DNA OS real boundary (127.0.0.1:8791). Loopback client of the SAME public boundary the Owner Surface uses. n8n is TEST DRIVER/OBSERVER only — NOT Core/Registry/decision/permission/repair authority.

eight_reusable_subworkflow_roles.TEST_CASE_RUNNER: TEST_CASE_RUNNER.n8n.json (Webhook -> Invoker -> Assertion -> Report). Parameterized by a test_case object.
eight_reusable_subworkflow_roles.DNA_OS_INVOKER: HTTP Request node -> http://127.0.0.1:8791{{path}} (real boundary). Never calls internal impl fns.
eight_reusable_subworkflow_roles.STATE_OBSERVER: follow-up HTTP Request GET (e.g. /owner/plan?command_id, /task/:id) to read terminal state.
eight_reusable_subworkflow_roles.EVENT_OBSERVER: HTTP Request to GET /owner/events?work_id (SSE) — read emitted SystemEvents.
eight_reusable_subworkflow_roles.ASSERTION_ENGINE: Code node evaluating declarative asserts (status/eq/exists/gte/contains/in) against the real response.
eight_reusable_subworkflow_roles.EVIDENCE_COLLECTOR: Code node captures {request, http_status, body_excerpt, observed_at} per case.
eight_reusable_subworkflow_roles.CLEANUP_RUNNER: only reversible/isolated writes are used; registry TEST_FIXTUREs are idempotent (duplicate gate) — no destructive cleanup needed. Extend here for future write tests.
